notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Tribute to the World Tree triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Elemental.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {1}.
When the Elemental dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, you may put the +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
